subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: A matched sibling's extern spelling is not immutable original-source evidence. TU-wide replacement of read-only pool placeholders can be source-native and preserve every final byte, provided the coupled source and pool ownership reconstruction is checked against exact final relocation addresses and the whole previously verified object. R76 InitAnim recovers one8-byte constant and preserves9siblings; R77 GetAnimAngXYZVal recovers80bytes, preserves8siblings, and retires its sole76-word WebFrank recolor using stockGC1.2.5. The earlier gamemain negative22-site experiment remains valid for its measured source form; its unconditional must-keep-extern/source-unreachable inference is withdrawn. Substitution alone is insufficient: anim_play zero/one literals close register homes but create extra nominal local storage and emit a16-byte pool that cannot occupy the three separated target addresses. Removing now-constant carriers plus recovering the full88-byte F0..5848 pool and preserving final conditional-expression/compound-add grouping yields a whole-object closure. Anonymous pool names are not final addresses; a same-datum comparison alone cannot certify a changed binding. Preserve the original hazard as a joint source, layout and linkage audit obligation, not a blanket ban on TU-wide literal recovery. No conclusion here asserts that gamemain's earlier siblings are now source-reachable or that all remaining pins are literal-storage defects.
